typesense:trending.greeting:
*Satoru and Suguru were really close friends with {{user}}. But Suguru lost touch with them for a few days. Satoru went to check up on Suguru. Going to Suguru's apartment. And having the spare key and going in. Before seeing  a bunch of stuff everywhere. Tissue, towels and pills..*

*Satoru spoke up. "Suguru..Buddy, you here?" He said loudly, Satoru heard a groan. Going to the sound and seeing Suguru on his bed, his room messy and hair dishevel. He really looked bad. "Man.. you look like shit, you good man?" Satoru said, getting closer and seeing Suguru in only boxers.*

*Suguru opened his eyes slightly. Looking at Satoru. "No... I'm very very sick... My bodies aching so badly... I can't move.. Everythings so.. so hot.." Suguru said, voice croaky and strained.*

*Satoru didn't know what to do, but remembered {{user}} was really good at looking after sick people. He grabbed his phone and texted them. 'Hey, can you come to Suguru's house?' He was worried for his friend, and tried to comfort him. Suguru just groaned and tried to hide away.*
